description: Dataset for "Congestion relief underpins the societal value of bike sharing is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jinhua Xu, Yuanyuan Wang. This dataset contains the empirical data used to investigate travel time savings associated with bike-sharing trips across Chinese cities. The dataset includes trip-level and city-level variables related to travel distance, travel time, generalized travel costs, urban congestion conditions, and transportation modes. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
